title: PercentileCloud — ring buffer percentiles, dynamic range map, history modes
description:
Implement the Spectral Percentile Cloud data pipeline that consumes SpectralAnalysisEngine frames and produces per-bin percentile / dynamic-range maps for the diagnostic GUI per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.2–12.3 and §12.8.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.2 (10th/50th/90th optional 99th percentiles; interpretation of narrow/wide bands)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.3 (Dynamic Range Map D(f) = Q_90(f) - Q_10(f))
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.8 (history windows: 2s, 5s, 10s, 30s, frozen capture, entire scan pass; history stops CPU when disabled)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §18.3 and §20 (background/message thread; fixed memory; quality levels do not alter EQ)
- Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.* multi-consumer snapshot API from phase G (read only — reuse; do not reimplement FFT)
- Sibling Source/UI/* patterns if present (read only)
- CMakeLists.txt (read only; i.3 owns CMake registration and processor taps)

Implement Source/UI/PercentileCloud.h and Source/UI/PercentileCloud.cpp:
1. PercentileCloud is a data path only (no JUCE Component painting in this task). Document that GUI paint happens in a later phase.
2. Consume frames ONLY via SpectralAnalysisEngine multi-consumer snapshot APIs (getLatestSpectrum / getSpectrumSnapshot or equivalent). Never own a second FFT engine.
3. Per log-frequency bin (or engine bin): maintain a fixed-capacity ring of recent S_t[k] (dB) samples and compute Q10, Q50 (median), Q90, and optionally Q99. Prefer an efficient fixed-buffer estimator (e.g. sorted scratch of known capacity, histogram bins, or P²-style) — confound: no unbounded vectors of history frames.
4. Dynamic Range Map: D(f) = Q_90(f) - Q_10(f) exposed as a parallel float array/span with the same bin count as the engine spectrum.
5. History modes: selectable window among 2s, 5s, 10s, 30s; Frozen holds the last completed statistics without consuming new frames (near-zero CPU beyond idle); Scan mode can accumulate for an entire scan pass when told scan is active. setHistoryWindow / setFrozen / setScanActive (names may match project style).
6. Threading: update()/processNewFrames() called from analyzer background or message thread only — never from processBlock. Snapshots for the GUI must be safe to read without blocking audio (double-buffer or atomics + fixed arrays).
7. prepare(sampleRate, maxBins, maxHistorySeconds) preallocates all rings/scratches once. reset() clears history. setEnabled(false) stops updates and releases CPU while retaining last valid snapshot if useful for GUI freeze.
8. Numerical guards: finite dB values, empty-history safe defaults (e.g. zeros or quiet-floor), bin count changes on engine re-prepare.
9. Do not modify PluginProcessor, CMakeLists, HeadroomHistogram, ResonancePersistenceMap, or tests.

C++20/JUCE style consistent with Source/. verification_commands left empty — C++ adapter infers cmake/ctest.
acceptance_criteria: PercentileCloud consumes SpectralAnalysisEngine spectrum snapshots and does not implement a second FFT/STFT engine
Per-bin Q10, Q50, and Q90 are computed from a fixed-capacity history ring; optional Q99 may be present
Dynamic Range Map D(f) = Q_90(f) - Q_10(f) is exposed with the same bin count as the spectrum
History modes support at least 2s/5s/10s/30s windows plus frozen and scan-pass accumulation; disabled/frozen paths stop expensive updates
All percentile computation runs off the audio thread; prepare bounds memory with no unbounded history growth
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add a second FFT/STFT engine or third-party FFT dependency
implement JUCE Component painting / editor wiring

allowed: fixed-capacity per-bin ring or histogram percentile estimator
reuse SpectralAnalysisEngine snapshot APIs as sole spectral input
forbidden: unbounded std::vector growth per frame without fixed cap
